ValidationRule.description: Submission, Approval, Rejection and Recall values autoset based on type of approval entry.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.RES_Config_Switch__c.RES_Validation_Rules_Off__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL($User.UserType, "AutomatedProcess")), OR( ISPICKVAL(RES_Entry_Type__c, "Submission"), ISPICKVAL(RES_Entry_Type__c, "Approval"), ISPICKVAL(RES_Entry_Type__c, "Rejection"), ISPICKVAL(RES_Entry_Type__c, "Recall") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only Correction is valid selection to create a Correction entry.
